inputs.description: App USB console (use the /dev/serial/by-id path: its ttyACM number changes after every reboot)
Apagar zephyr/, modules/, bootloader/ e .west/? (só o que o west baixou)
Test folder to build for native_sim and debug

tasks.label: Manifest: Fetch (west init + update)
tasks.detail: First run: west init -l manifest, west update (Zephyr, modules and MCUboot at the versions pinned in manifest/west.yml), west zephyr-export and then Generate Demo Keys (existing keys are kept).
tasks.command: if [ -d .west ]; then echo '.west/ already exists: skipping west init'; else west init -l manifest; fi && west update && west zephyr-export && ./tools/keys/genkeys.sh

tasks.label: Manifest: Clean (apaga zephyr/, modules/, bootloader/, .west/)
tasks.detail: Opposite of Manifest: Fetch. Deletes everything west downloaded and the west workspace marker (all git-ignored). Asks for confirmation.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:confirmClean}" = "sim" ]; then for d in zephyr modules bootloader .west; do if [ -e "$d" ]; then echo "removendo $d/"; rm -rf "$d"; fi; done; echo 'Pronto. Rode "Manifest: Fetch" para baixar de novo.'; else echo 'Cancelado.'; fi

tasks.label: Generate Demo Keys
tasks.detail: Generates the demo MCUboot signing/encryption keys (tools/keys/genkeys.sh).

tasks.label: West Build
tasks.detail: Sysbuild (MCUboot + app) for weact_stm32h743 into app/build (-p auto), with app/debug.conf (all commented out by default).
tasks.command: west build -b weact_stm32h743 --sysbuild -p auto -s app -d app/build -- -DBOARD_ROOT=${workspaceFolder} -Dapp_EXTRA_CONF_FILE=debug.conf

tasks.label: West Build (v2.0.0)
tasks.detail: Same build with VERSION_MAJOR = 2 into app/build_v200: the update image of the Robot tests 07-08. app/VERSION is put back at the end.
tasks.command: mkdir -p app/build_v200 && cp app/VERSION app/build_v200/VERSION.factory && trap 'cp app/build_v200/VERSION.factory app/VERSION' EXIT && sed -i 's/^VERSION_MAJOR = .*/VERSION_MAJOR = 2/' app/VERSION && west build -b weact_stm32h743 --sysbuild -p auto -s app -d app/build_v200 -- -DBOARD_ROOT=${workspaceFolder} -Dapp_EXTRA_CONF_FILE=debug.conf

tasks.label: West Flash (ST-Link)
tasks.detail: Runs West Build, then flashes the mcuboot domain and the app domain through ST-Link (STM32CubeProgrammer from STM32CubeIDE). Also the preLaunchTask of the ST-Link debug configs.
tasks.command: west flash -d app/build --runner stm32cubeprogrammer --domain mcuboot && west flash -d app/build --runner stm32cubeprogrammer --domain app

tasks.label: Native Build
tasks.detail: Builds the app for native_sim/native/64 into app/build_native, with app/debug.conf. Also the preLaunchTask of the native_sim debug config.
tasks.command: west build -b native_sim/native/64 -p auto -s app -d app/build_native -- -DBOARD_ROOT=${workspaceFolder} -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE=debug.conf

tasks.label: Test Build (native_sim debug)
tasks.detail: Builds one tests/<folder> for native_sim/native/64 at -Og into tests/build_debug (pristine when the folder changes). Used by the test debug launch.
tasks.command: west build -b native_sim/native/64 -p auto -s tests/${input:hostTest} -d tests/build_debug -- -DBOARD_ROOT=${workspaceFolder} -DCONFIG_DEBUG_OPTIMIZATIONS=y

tasks.label: Native Run
tasks.detail: Runs the native_sim executable from app/build_native, where flash.bin (the simulated NOR with the users) lives, same as the native_sim debug config.

tasks.label: Twister (device)
tasks.detail: Runs tests/ on the weact_stm32h743, flashing over UART (tools/twister/flash_uart.py) (twister-out-device).

tasks.label: Robot (board acceptance)
tasks.detail: Both acceptance suites on the board, 01-08: users, then firmware update (tests/robot/results/report.html).

tasks.label: Robot (users)
tasks.detail: Suite 01__users.robot, tests 01-05: factory version, add, block, delete, the 50-user limit. USB console only, ~40 s.

tasks.label: Robot (firmware update)
tasks.detail: Suite 02__firmware_update.robot, tests 06-08: unsigned image refused, rollback, confirmed update keeps the users. Needs West Build and West Build (v2.0.0).

tasks.label: Robot (upload speed)
tasks.detail: Same image to MCUboot slot1 with mcumgr and with smpclient, timed; the board stays on v1.0.0 (tests/robot/results/report.html).

tasks.label: Twister Coverage (host)
tasks.detail: Runs every test in tests/ on native_sim/native/64 with gcovr coverage of gzm/ (twister-out-coverage/coverage/index.html).
tasks.command: ZEPHYR_TOOLCHAIN_VARIANT=zephyr west twister --board-root . -T tests -p native_sim/native/64 --coverage --coverage-tool gcovr --coverage-basedir gzm -O twister-out-coverage
